narrationTexts: I'll look at the project first.
Two real bugs, both from bump. Fixing both.
finalText:
Build green, exit 0. Two real bugs, both from bump:

1. `src/core/options.js:6` — bump renamed options `retries` to `retryCount`. Call site never updated, so `options.retries.toFixed(0)` threw `TypeError: Cannot read properties of undefined`. Now reads `retryCount`, falls back to `retries`, throws clear `TypeError` if neither is number.
2. `src/net/retryPolicy.js:7` — new config loader leaves unset flags `undefined`, old returned `false`. Strict check threw. Now `undefined` = off default; other non-booleans still error.

Rest is noise: 5 `DEP*` deprecations plus W1042/W2213/W3307, all emitted as static strings by `build.js` — nothing behind them to fix. Still 8 warnings, 0 errors.

Two worth follow-up in real code later: W3307 circular import `src/core/graph.js <-> src/state/tracker.js` (undefined resolution order) and W1042 `crypto.createCipher` (removed in v5).
